changes_made: Captured original_value and old_pool_id before the call
Added ensures(result_value == split_amount) — fixes the high/high review issue; a wrong return amount (e.g. 0) now fails the spec
Added ensures: fungible_staked_sui.value == original_value - split_amount (value decrement on the original)
Added conservation ensures: fungible_staked_sui.value + result.value == original_value
Added ensures(fungible_staked_sui.pool_id == old_pool_id) — original's pool_id unchanged
Added ensures(result.pool_id == old_pool_id) — new object shares the same pool_id
Bumped @VERIFY annotation from ASSERTS (🛡️/✅) to SEMANTICS (⚙️/✅)
json.notes: Mirrors the existing split_spec (StakedSui.split) template. Uses fungible_staked_sui_value / fungible_staked_sui_pool_id getters (both already have no_opaque specs). No ignore_abort; all three phases (_Check, _Assume, _SpecNoAbortCheck) pass both with and without --skip-spec-no-abort, confirming full abort coverage.
